The '''Mecetti File''' was a [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] containing information that implicated [[House Mecetti]] in anti-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] activities. [[House Pelagia]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] [[Pellas Agri]] and [[Janna Pallask]] sought to obtain the Mecetti File and release the information to drive a wedge in the relationship between Mecetti and the Empire.<ref name="MF">{{WEGCite|story=The Mecetti File|book=Tapani Sector Instant Adventures}}</ref>
